milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the red concrete powder already exists in the scene at relative position (5, 0, 5) and the agent must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate it has been 'found'. The target is the base of the 2-high red concrete powder stack. max_distance=5 is appropriate since the sandbox preview confirmed the agent reaches the block within ~5 steps (~7 diagonal blocks from spawn). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the agent is actually looking toward the block, not just passing nearby.
